verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Floot importing a Figma file or turning an existing design or mockup into an app. The closest item, pointing at an element or annotating a screenshot for the assistant (floot-docs-6), reads as feedback on the app being built, not importing an outside design. Since design import is a fair question for a prompt-to-app builder, the axis applies, and missing evidence means none rather than na.
